title: Tarkir: Dragonstorm Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: An Abzan leader who always answers the call of kin and clan.

entities.name: Alesha
entities.description: A khan of the Mardu who ensured her people's survival.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: The khan of the Mardu.

entities.name: Sarkhan
entities.description: A planeswalker linked to Tarkir's dragons who wants Tarkir to be what it was meant to be.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: The Sultai ruler whose time in power ended when rebels breached Qarsi Palace.

entities.name: Eshki Dragonclaw
entities.description: A Temur leader who protects and works to rebuild the Temur.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: A hunter who spent his life feeding Atarka's desires.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragon whose desires and hungers Surrak served.

entities.name: Kotis, the Fangkeeper
entities.description: A keeper who speaks of life essence returning to the earth.

entities.name: Felothar
entities.description: An Abzan leader who speaks of perennation.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A Jeskai leader who thanks those who helped build a clan and school.

entities.name: Shiko

entities.description: A Jeskai member Narset thanks.

entities.description: A Jeskai member Narset thanks.

events.summary: Rebels breach Qarsi Palace and Sidisi realizes her rule is ending.
events.quote: As the rebels breached Qarsi Palace, she realized her time in power was at its end.

events.summary: Abzan forces rally and drive back Sarkhan's dragon horde.
events.quote: The Abzan forces rallied to the call, driving back Sarkhan's feral dragon horde.

events.summary: The essence of Tarkir is shaped into draconic embodiments of the re-formed clans.
events.quote: The essence of Tarkir was shaped into draconic embodiments of the re-formed clans.

events.summary: The Sultai approach silently and the Temur respond deafeningly.
events.quote: The Sultai approach was silent. The Temur response was deafening.
